edition.cue: Order the pizza when Peter races across the city on a delivery.

s.note: Golden dough knots tossed in garlic butter and fresh parsley.
s.how: Cut 300g pizza dough into 8 strips and tie into knots. Cover on a lined tray and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 230°C conventional for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 40g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves over low heat for 2 minutes. Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter and 2 tbsp chopped parsley.

s.note: Hot potato and onion knishes with yellow mustard.
s.how: Boil 700g potatoes and mash with 1 onion fried soft in 30g butter, plus salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8, put a mound of potato on each, fold up and pinch closed. Brush with 1 beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with yellow mustard.

m.note: Thin crisp pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and cupping pepperoni.
m.how: Mix 380g bread flour, 2g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt and 245ml cool water. Knead 8 minutes, divide into 2 balls and refrigerate covered for 24 to 48 hours to cold-ferment. Bring to room temperature for 2 hours. Heat a pizza steel in the oven at its maximum temperature, about 250 to 275°C, for 45 minutes. Stretch each dough ball thin. Spread each with half of 200g crushed tomatoes and top with half of 200g low-moisture mozzarella and 100g thinly sliced cupping pepperoni. Bake one at a time on the hot steel for about 7 minutes, until the crust is cooked and crisp. Cut both pizzas into wedges for four people.

w.note: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter and stacked with maple syrup.
w.how: Separate 2 eggs. Mix 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 20g sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk the yolks with 180ml buttermilk and fold into the flour. Whip the whites to soft peaks and gently fold through. Melt a little of 30g butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook eight small pancakes in batches, about 2 minutes until bubbles set, then flip and cook 1 minute. Stack two per person and serve with 80ml maple syrup.

d.note: Cold brew with milk, ice and vanilla ice cream.
d.how: Steep 80g coarsely ground coffee beans in 800ml cold water, covered in the fridge, for 12 to 18 hours. Strain through a coffee filter. Divide 400g ice between four glasses, add 150ml cold brew and 100ml full cream milk to each, then top each with 50ml vanilla ice cream. Refrigerate leftover cold brew.
